facets.title: Feature availability
facets.measure: native, composed, partial, absent or unknown
facets.rule: Evidence-backed capability claim; never a correctness verdict.

facets.title: Conformance
facets.measure: exact output, invariant or standard vector
facets.rule: Gate only against the case oracle.

facets.title: Signal quality
facets.measure: response, passband, alias rejection, pitch and duration
facets.rule: Not a perceptual-quality or standards-certification claim.

facets.title: Performance
facets.measure: warm wall time with repeated runs and fresh driver processes
facets.rule: Includes adapter I/O. No rankings between unequal integration modes.

facets.title: Memory
facets.measure: peak RSS, managed heap and retained resources
facets.rule: Measure process trees and native allocations where possible.

facets.title: Install and delivery size
facets.measure: package, dependency closure, binary and browser transfer bytes
facets.rule: Report compressed and installed size separately.

facets.title: Platform reach
facets.measure: OS, architecture, runtime and browser matrix
facets.rule: Record the exact environment on every run.

facets.title: Streaming behavior
facets.measure: time to first frame, bounded memory and chunk invariance
facets.rule: Do not equate batch throughput with streaming fitness.

facets.title: Determinism
facets.rule: Seed stochastic processors and report unavoidable variance.
